documents.title: Bambu PLA Basic Safety Data Sheet (SDS20250724A00)
Bambu PLA Basic Filament Hex Code Table
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate, glue compatibility and required parameters

notes: Scope: every spec is product-scoped. Both variants (CMYK Lithophane Bundle; + Backlight Board) carry the same four 1 kg PLA Basic spools; the manifest row has no sku_codes and no value_labels, and the page has no colour option group.

Source of the specs: the PLA Basic TDS V3.0 (the store page describes the product as 'a four-color bundle of PLA Basic filaments ... cyan, magenta, yellow, and white'). The bundle page itself links only the CMYK lithophane wiki guide, a banner video and the Lithophane Maker YouTube channel.

TDS values with no registry key (not stored): Z-direction mechanical values (tensile 31 ± 3 MPa, elongation 7.5 ± 1.3 %, bending modulus 2370 ± 150 MPa, bending strength 59 ± 6 MPa, impact 13.8 ± 0.9 kJ/m²), Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa, Z 2060 ± 170 MPa), notched impact X-Y 7.9 ± 1.2 kJ/m², HDT at 1.8 MPa 54 °C, melt index 23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature N/A, saturated water absorption 0.43% (25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity < 20% RH, bed surface preparation Glue, retraction length 0.6 - 1.0 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, max overhang angle 55°, max bridging length 30 mm, spool material ABS (temperature resistance 70 °C), spool size diameter 200 mm / height 67 mm, annealing 50 to 60 °C for 6 to 12 h, heatbed drying (X1 Series) 60 - 70 °C 12 h, and the chemical-resistance rows.

thermal.chamber_temp is not curated: the TDS 'Chamber Temperature 25 - 45 °C' is a recommended printing range, while the registry key is a single number (a printer's chamber temperature). It is stated, so it is not declared not_published.
material.spool_type is not curated: the TDS states the spool material (ABS) and size, not a spool type; the store page's Type option 'Filament with spool' is the page layer's.
identity.* is not curated: the SDS model 'A00-xx' is the PLA Basic filament's model code, not this bundle's.

package.contents / in_the_box: no official in-the-box list exists in the documents read; the page only says the bundle includes cyan, magenta, yellow and white PLA Basic, and the second Bundle value adds a Backlight Board.
printing.layer_height is not curated: the page FAQ suggests 'layer heights between 0.08mm and 0.12mm' for lithophanes (usage prose, a printer key).

Store-page consistency: the parsed page carries only not_found rows (material.diameter, material.net_weight, material.density, print_settings.nozzle_temp), which the curated values fill. Its Size value '1kg*4' agrees with the per-spool net weight; its FAQ bed temperature 45-50℃ differs from the TDS (conflict on print_settings.bed_temp). The page's Quick Walkthrough table (hex codes, nozzle '0.2 mm (Recommended) or 0.4 mm', four build plates) sits in featureConfig.richText ('$160'), which the extractor does not parse; its hex codes agree with the hex table.
Not read (not cached): the CMYK Lithophane Printing Guide wiki page linked by the store page (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/knowledge-sharing/CMYK-color-lithophane-printing-instructions).
